mapper.sql: id, scene, target, code_hash, expires_at, attempts, used, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO verification_code (scene, target, code_hash, expires_at, attempts, used, create_time) VALUES (#{scene}, #{target}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{attempts}, #{used}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM verification_code WHERE scene = #{scene} AND target = #{target} AND used = 0 AND expires_at > NOW() ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE verification_code SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE verification_code SET used = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE verification_code SET used = 1 WHERE scene = #{scene} AND target = #{target} AND used = 0
